dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY includes with .INC extension, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, and CALL to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCSJOB, etc.)
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)
SELECT ... ASSIGN FILE-NAME with LINE SEQUENTIAL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing system — specifically the 'SOKATU3100' component which generates and sends detailed claim submission documents (診療報酬請求明細書送付書) for monthly billing
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software. It processes medical insurance claim records, reads/writes indexed and sequential files, and produces a claim submission cover document (送付書). It calls multiple ORCA subsystem routines for job management, printing, and date conversion.

notable_features: 49 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCSJOB, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
LINE SEQUENTIAL files for update and error output
REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
Revision history embedded in comments (versions 01.00.01 through 01.00.03)
Japanese text in comments (latin-1 encoded Shift-JIS/EUC-JP mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based batch
INITIALIZE used extensively for area clearing
verdict.notes: Comment text is garbled (mojibake) because the file was decoded as latin-1 but the original encoding is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS. The source is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA healthcare software. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 76303 bytes total; the procedure division logic is only partially visible but the structure is consistent throughout.
